name: River Street
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. To the north is the city wall, and to the south
desc3: there is a tall, rickety house, whose door is set with a tarnished
desc4: brass knocker. There seems to be no-one home, as there are no light
desc5: lit. River street continues to the east and west.
